VANTA_CLIENT_ID.description: Vanta OAuth2 client ID minted at Vanta admin -> Settings -> API Access. Normally pre-configured on the dispatcher as a varenv — leave blank in the Run form to use the agent-side value.

VANTA_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Vanta OAuth2 client secret paired with VANTA_CLIENT_ID. Exchanged for a short-lived Bearer at /oauth/token on each run. Normally pre-configured on the dispatcher as a varenv — leave blank in the Run form to use the agent-side value.

VANTA_API_URL.description: Vanta API base URL. Default 'https://api.vanta.com'. Override only for private-preview / EU deployments.

VANTA_MODE.description: Comma-separated list of what to import. Default 'tests'. Valid: tests (failing controls -> vulns), resources (monitored assets -> hosts), people (workforce inventory -> synthetic hosts).

VANTA_FRAMEWORK.description: Restrict tests to a Vanta framework key (e.g. 'soc2', 'iso27001', 'hipaa', 'gdpr'). Omit for all frameworks.

VANTA_PAGE_SIZE.description: Rows per API page. Default 100 (Vanta max).

VANTA_MAX_PAGES.description: Hard cap on pages fetched per mode. Default 50 (= 5k rows at the default page size).

VANTA_MIN_SEVERITY.description: Client-side severity floor for failing tests. Valid: info | low | medium | high | critical. Default 'medium'.

name: vanta
title: Vanta
description: Vanta continuous-compliance import. OAuth2 client credentials, then walks the public REST API (default https://api.vanta.com/v1/): failing tests become Faraday vulnerabilities tagged '[GRC]' on the affected asset (or a synthetic 'grc:vanta:global' host if the test isn't scoped to one), monitored resources become Faraday hosts tagged 'grc:vanta:asset-inventory', and people become synthetic workforce hosts. Set VANTA_FRAMEWORK=soc2|iso27001|hipaa|gdpr to scope tests to one framework. Severity is normalised from Vanta's enum into Faraday's info/low/medium/high/critical scheme; VANTA_MIN_SEVERITY drops rows below the floor. External IDs are stable so re-runs are idempotent. Pagination via pageCursor; backs off 30s on HTTP 429.
